subject: Encord & Saronic
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saronic's name came up during a conversation we had with Controp at our
Physical AI event last week in SF, so wanted to reach out to see if you'd
be open to a quick chat?

We've just starting working on projects with a bunch of your autonomous
vehicle peers (i.e. The Royal Navy, Elbit, Anduril, Rebellion Defences..)
to support the fine tuning of their object detection perception models with
the goal of speeding up expansion into new use cases - particularly focused
on agentic workflows to automate their annotation pipeline as their
requirements grow in complexity and scale.

raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our team in the coming
weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on what
we're building. We're pretty open Friday, however happy to work around your
schedule!

subject: Encord & Blinkfire
text:
Hi [NAME],

I read the article with ESA talking about how Blinkfire owns its technology
stack, including your computer vision and AI  models, so wanted to reach
out to see if you'd be open to a quick chat on what we're building?

We recently started working with Hudl, Veo and Spiideo on developing sports
analytics computer vision models with the goal of speeding up their
expansion into new sports & new products releases.

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while
keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data
mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos
natively.

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord, we're a data development
platform built for advanced computer vision and multimodal AI teams to
build better models (~5 years old, 70+ employees & raised $50M+ funding)

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our leadership team in the
coming weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback.
We're pretty open Friday, however happy to work around your schedule!
